# Ananda Thirumana Maaligai A/C

> Built brick by brick since 1994 on GST Road: a 6,000 sq.ft A/C hall for up to 900 guests, with A/C rooms, two lifts and parking for 100 vehicles.

Website: https://atmchennai.in/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90422 39267

## Key facts
- the year we opened 1994
- 900 guests at most

## Facilities
- 6,000 sq.ft A/C hall (first floor)
- 5,000 sq.ft hall (ground floor)
- A/C dining hall
- Two lifts
- 24x7 power backup
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Photo & video services
- Flower & stage decoration
- Disabled accessible
- Parking for 100 vehicles

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Ananda Thirumana Maaligai A/C hold?
Ananda Thirumana Maaligai hosts up to 900 guests in its 6,000 sq.ft air-conditioned hall.

### Where is Ananda Thirumana Maaligai A/C?
No. 220, G.S.T. Road, Chromepet, Chennai 600 044 (Office: Mon–Sat 10 AM – 7 PM · Sun & holidays 9 AM – 12 PM).

### What facilities does Ananda Thirumana Maaligai A/C have?
6,000 sq.ft A/C hall (first floor), 5,000 sq.ft hall (ground floor), A/C dining hall, Two lifts, 24x7 power backup, Fully equipped kitchen, Photo & video services, Flower & stage decoration, Disabled accessible, Parking for 100 vehicles.

### When is the office open?
Monday to Saturday 10 AM to 7 PM, and Sundays and holidays 9 AM to 12 PM.

### Is there parking?
Yes, spacious parking for 100 vehicles, two- and four-wheelers.
